snippet.title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
From the creative minds of YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

A girl who's lost her home…
…Joins hands with a mysterious boy…
…and sets out into the unknown.

Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden is available now on Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®4  and Steam®!
